Each part is its own slide deck and its own URL, so contributors can edit one section without rewriting the others. Decks inherit the same Reveal.js chrome from `presentations/_quarto.yml`. A part can override that in its own YAML when it needs a different theme or layout.

Inside a deck: open the slide list from the menu at the top left, move with the arrows or the left and right keys, and search the text of that deck. Escape returns to this site’s home page. The edge arrows fade when the pointer is still.
